description: This PHP file defines the JobCategoryController class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Admin Controller namespace. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a component for managing job categories in the UI.

classes.name: JobCategoryController
classes.description: Controller for managing job categories in the admin module, extends from AbstractVueController, responsible for setting up the Vue component for job categories.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component before rendering by initializing a Vue component named 'job-category-list' and setting it in the controller.
